resources.string: Shows the pill at the camera hole. Turn this off to remove the pill and the notice.
Skerry draws a small pill at the camera hole. Allow the overlay permission and the pill can sit on top of the launcher. Skerry does not use an Accessibility service.
Only apps you turn on can appear on the pill. With none turned on, Skerry shows nothing.
Shown while the island is on
The pill is at the camera hole.
